app.name: Rail Builder
app.description: Find out which wooden train layouts you can build right now with the pieces you already own.

home.title: No more <hl>same old oval</hl> every Sunday.
home.subtitle: Tell us which pieces are in your box: the app shows every layout you can build right now and guides your child step by step.
home.planTitle: An oval of 8 curves and 4 straights, with a train running on it
home.problem: 12 curves, 6 straights, 1 bridge, 2 switches… and still the same oval?
home.problemText: Sets pile up birthday after birthday, but nobody really knows what they can build. The app works it out for you.
home.showcaseTitle: {count, plural, one {# layout} other {# layouts}} with just a starter set
home.showcaseText: Every suggested layout is checked: all pieces fit together and the loop closes. No impossible suggestions.
home.step1Text: Add your sets in one tap, then adjust piece by piece.
home.step2Text: Layouts you can build right now, and the ones missing just one to three pieces.
home.step3Text: Your child follows the plan step by step, then taps “I built it!”.
home.kidText: Put a tablet on the floor next to the track, and off you go.
home.kidPoint1: One piece at a time, highlighted on the plan
home.kidPoint4: No ads, no purchases, no external links

pieces.title: Piece catalogue
pieces.intro: Each piece is described by its shape and its ends (male or female): that is how we can check that a layout closes.
pieces.setsIntro: Adding a set puts all of its pieces in your box at once.
